## data clean

```{r}
#raw = read.csv("data/raw1.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>% filter(!is.na(age))
#gpt = read.csv("data/gpt_pilot_responses.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

dt <- fread("data/raw.csv") %>%  slice(-c(1,2)) 

# --- 1. Import & clean column names ---
clean_names <- names(dt) %>%
  trimws() %>%
  str_replace_all("\\s+", "_") %>%
  str_replace_all("_+$", "")

setnames(dt, clean_names)

# --- 2. Separate metadata vs question columns ---
qcols <- grep("^\\d+_", names(dt), value = TRUE)
meta  <- setdiff(names(dt), qcols)

# --- 3. Long reshape of question blocks ---
long <- dt %>% #986
  mutate(age=as.numeric(age),id=ResponseId) %>%
  filter(Finished=="True") %>% #909
  filter(Q_RecaptchaScore>0.5) %>%  #893
  filter("Duration (in seconds)" > 120) %>% #893
  filter(attention =="Pride") %>% #871
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(qcols),
    names_to = c("behavior", "measure"),
    names_pattern = "^(\\d+)_(.*)$",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>% 
 filter(!is.na(value) & value != "")

# --- 4. Recode values into clean categories ---
long <- long %>%
  mutate(value = case_when(
    value == "Celebrate/praise" ~ "Praise",
    value == "Do nothing" ~ "Do nothing",
    value == "Gossip about/discuss with/complain to others informally" ~ "Gossip",
    value == "Informing authority such as police" ~ "Inform authority",
    value == "Physical confrontation" ~ "Physical confrontation",
    value == "Stay away or keeping distance from the actor" ~ "Stay away",
    value == "Support the actor" ~ "Support",
    value == "Verbal reprimand/verbal confrontation" ~ "Verbal confrontation",
    TRUE ~ value
  ))

```

```{r}
# --- 5. Pivot wider  ---
wide1 <- long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = "measure",
    values_from = "value"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    appropriate = case_when(
      appro == "Not at all inappropriate" ~ 1,
      appro == "Somewhat inappropriate" ~ 2,
      appro == "Inappropriate" ~ 3,
      appro == "Very inappropriate" ~ 4,
      appro == "Extremly inappropriate" ~ 5
    ),
    wrong = case_when(
      wrong == "Not at all wrong" ~ 1,
      wrong == "Somewhat wrong" ~ 2,
      wrong == "Wrong" ~ 3,
      wrong == "Very wrong" ~ 4,
      wrong == "Extremly wrong" ~ 5
    ))%>% 
  mutate(behavior = as.integer(gsub("X", "", behavior))) %>% 
  mutate(actor_gender = ifelse(behavior<455,"male","female"))

# --- 6. emotion long form and rename ---
# Example mapping
emo_map <- c(
  "1" = "Shame",
  "2" = "Guilt",
  "3" = "Contempt",
  "4" = "Anger",
  "5" = "Disgust",
  "6" = "Embarrassment",
  "7" = "Pride",
  "8" = "Compassion"
)

# Select only columns with emotions and their strengths
emo_cols <- c("actor_emo", "friend_emo", "acq_emo", "stran_emo")

wide <- wide1 %>%
  # 1. Replace NA in all strength columns with none
    # convert all strength columns to numeric first
  # replace NA with 0
  mutate(across(matches("strength_\\d+$"), ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, "Not at all"))) %>%
  # 2. Rename columns based on emo_map
  rename_with(
    ~ {
      colnames <- .
      sapply(colnames, function(col) {
        # Check if column is a strength column
        if (str_detect(col, "strength_\\d+$")) {
          # Extract the number
          num <- str_extract(col, "\\d+$")
          # Replace number with emotion name from emo_map
          str_replace(col, paste0("_strength_", num), paste0("_strength_", emo_map[num]))
        } else {
          col
        }
      })
    }
  ) 

# Columns with renamed strength (emotion names)
strength_cols <- names(wide)[str_detect(names(wide), "_strength_")]

# --- 7. Pivot strength columns to long ---
strength_long <- wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(strength_cols),
    names_to = c("emo_type", "emotion"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_strength_(.+)",
    values_to = "strength_value"
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(strength_value)) %>% 
  mutate(
    strength_value = case_when(
      strength_value == "Not at all"   ~ 0,
      strength_value == "A little"     ~ 1,
      strength_value == "Moderate"     ~ 2,
      strength_value == "A lot"        ~ 3,
      strength_value == "Extremely"    ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    emo_type = case_when(
      emo_type == "actor_emo"     ~ "emotion_actor",
      emo_type == "friend_emo"    ~ "emotion_friend",
      emo_type == "acq_emo"       ~ "emotion_acquaintance",
      emo_type == "stran_emo"     ~ "emotion_stranger",
      TRUE                         ~ emo_type 
    )
  ) 

# --- 8. Arrange columns (id first, then demographics, then items) ---
df <- strength_long %>%
  select(id, gender, age, race, education, behavior:strength_value) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.character) & -id, as.factor)) 
```


```{r}
write.csv(wide, "data/human-wide.csv")
write.csv(df, "data/human-long.csv")
```
